catalogue: Australian external pedestrian doors, security screens, shutters and garage access doors

objects.name: external door, screen and shutter opening system
objects.definition: The coordinated physical construction at an external pedestrian or vehicle opening, including the selected door, frame or guides, movement hardware, weathering, seals, locks, fixings and any separate screen or shutter.
functions: Close and open an external wall opening
Carry selected access, security and wind evidence

cad.pattern: One coordinated assembly per external wall opening
cad.placement: Within and around the documented wall opening
cad.opening: Contains the operable clear opening and movement envelope
cad.load: Selected door reactions transfer through frame, guides and fixings to supporting structure

notes: Performance belongs to the complete selected product and installation; a group of visually similar components is not automatically compliant.

objects.name: external pedestrian doorset
objects.definition: A complete external doorway product or construction for people, including one or more moving leaves, a perimeter frame, threshold, movement and locking hardware, seals, fixings and weathering interfaces.
functions: Coordinate security, air sealing and weathering

cad.opening: Leaf movement and clear passage remain explicit
cad.load: Leaf and user actions through hardware and frame to wall support

objects.name: single hinged external doorset
objects.definition: An external pedestrian doorset with one leaf rotating about hinges or pivots at one vertical edge.
functions: Close against a weathered frame and threshold

cad.pattern: One rotating leaf in one frame
cad.opening: Swept leaf volume and clear opening are stored separately
cad.load: Leaf reactions through hinges to jamb and wall

objects.name: paired hinged external doorset
objects.definition: An external doorset with two meeting swing leaves, normally with one active leaf and one inactive leaf secured by bolts or other meeting hardware.
functions: Secure and weather the leaf meeting line

cad.pattern: Two leaves meeting near opening centre
cad.opening: Each leaf has its own swept volume and operating state
cad.load: Each leaf transfers through its own hinges; meeting hardware transfers closure loads

notes: French door describes a commonly glazed style; paired operation and construction remain separate axes.

objects.name: external pivot doorset
objects.definition: An external doorset whose leaf rotates on aligned top and bottom pivots located at or inboard from the leaf edge rather than on ordinary side-mounted butt hinges.
functions: Carry the leaf through a top and bottom pivot system
Allow a deliberately offset rotation axis

cad.pattern: One leaf rotating about an offset vertical axis
cad.opening: Heel and leading-edge sweeps are both checked
cad.load: Most leaf weight to bottom pivot and supporting construction

objects.name: stable external doorset
objects.definition: A hinged external door divided horizontally into separately operable upper and lower leaves that can also be secured to move as one door.
functions: Allow independent upper-leaf ventilation or communication
Secure the two leaves together when required

cad.opening: Each half has a separate swing state
cad.load: Each leaf through its hinges to the jamb

notes: The horizontal meeting joint requires explicit weathering and operating hardware.

objects.name: solid-panel external sliding doorset
objects.definition: An external doorset with an opaque or substantially solid leaf translating along a track outside, inside or within the wall line rather than rotating on hinges.
functions: Close the opening with a solid panel and selected seals

cad.placement: External pedestrian opening with panel parking run
cad.opening: Panel overlap and residual clear width remain explicit
cad.load: Leaf to rollers, track supports and wall structure

notes: An exposed sliding leaf needs a documented weathering method; overlap alone is not proof of air or water performance.

objects.name: entrance door sidelight assembly
objects.definition: A fixed framed panel beside an external entrance leaf, glazed or opaque, coupled into the entrance frame and wall-opening weathering system.
functions: Fill the side portion of a wide entrance opening
Admit light or provide an opaque side panel

cad.pattern: One fixed panel on one or both sides of entrance leaf
cad.opening: Does not contribute to operable clear width
cad.load: Panel actions through frame and couplers to wall

notes: Reuse the existing glazing objects when the sidelight is glazed.

objects.name: entrance door highlight assembly
objects.definition: A fixed framed panel above an external entrance door or door-and-sidelight combination, separated by a transom and glazed or filled as selected.
functions: Fill the opening above the doorset

cad.pattern: One fixed panel above entrance opening
cad.placement: Between door frame head or transom and structural opening head
cad.load: Panel actions to coupled frame and wall

objects.name: external door frame and threshold assembly
objects.definition: The load-carrying and weathering boundary around an external pedestrian leaf, comprising the head, jambs, stop or rebate, threshold or sill, anchors, packers and perimeter interfaces.
functions: Bound the closed leaf and clear opening
Connect weathering and seals to the wall and floor

cad.placement: Between wall opening and door leaf
cad.opening: Inside faces and stop or rebate define leaf and passage clearances
cad.load: Leaf, latch and weather actions through anchors to wall and floor

objects.name: external pedestrian-door weathering system
objects.definition: The coordinated sill or threshold, flashings, perimeter sealant, compression seals, bottom seal, drips and drainage paths that limit air and water entry around an external pedestrian door.
functions: Drain water away from the doorway
Restrict air and wind-driven rain entry
Join the doorset to wall and floor control layers

cad.pattern: Continuous coordinated perimeter with drainage at sill
cad.opening: Seals follow the operable leaf perimeter without blocking drainage
cad.load: Non-structural weathering components except traffic at threshold

notes: No single generic threshold resolves weather, accessibility and drainage for every exposure.

objects.name: external pedestrian-door hardware system
objects.definition: The selected set of hinges or pivots, operating furniture, latch, lock, bolts, closer, stops and security fittings that supports, moves, secures and controls an external pedestrian leaf.
functions: Support and operate the door leaf
Latch and lock the closed door
Control opening and closing where required

cad.pattern: Discrete scheduled fittings on leaf, frame, floor or wall
cad.placement: At hinge axis, operating edge and control points
cad.end: Supported, latched or controlled leaf state
cad.opening: Hardware projections and swing clearances remain explicit
cad.load: Leaf and user actions through fixings to reinforced leaf and frame

notes: Reuse generic lock cylinders, closer bodies and seals where product identity is genuinely shared; exposure suitability remains explicit.

objects.name: external pedestrian door leaf
objects.definition: The moving panel that closes an external pedestrian doorway, with construction and finish selected for its exposure, dimensions, hardware, weathering and documented performance roles.
functions: Open and close the pedestrian passage
Form part of the external envelope
Carry hinges, locks, seals and finishes

cad.pattern: One panel per selected leaf position
cad.opening: Thickness, swing or travel changes the clear opening
cad.load: Self-weight and wind through movement hardware to frame

objects.name: solid-timber panelled external door leaf
objects.definition: An external leaf built from solid or laminated timber stiles and rails containing one or more solid, laminated or engineered timber panels.
attributes: finish on all faces and edges

cad.opening: Panels and any glazing sit within rails and stiles
cad.load: Leaf self-weight through joinery and hinges

notes: Solid timber panelled does not mean the leaf is one solid slab.

objects.name: timber-faced flush external door leaf
objects.definition: An external flush leaf with substantially flat timber, plywood or external-grade engineered face skins bonded to a perimeter frame and selected core.
functions: Carry entrance hardware and selected glazing
Receive an exterior coating or veneer finish

cad.pattern: Flat rectangular leaf with layered internal construction
cad.load: Faces, frame and core act as documented for the selected product

objects.name: moulded composite external door leaf
objects.definition: An external leaf with moulded or pressed composite face skins bonded to a framed or solid core to form panel-like profiles without traditional separate timber panels.
functions: Carry entrance hardware and factory openings

cad.opening: Moulded relief remains surface geometry rather than separate loose panels
cad.load: Selected composite construction to hinges

objects.name: steel-faced insulated external door leaf
objects.definition: An external pedestrian leaf with formed steel face sheets around an insulating or composite core and reinforced edge or hardware zones.
functions: Provide a durable metal-faced external closure
Carry hinges, lock and perimeter seals

cad.opening: Hardware and glazing penetrations interrupt skins and core
cad.load: Composite leaf actions to hinges

notes: Metal facing and insulation do not establish a fire, acoustic or thermal rating without complete product evidence.

objects.name: glass-fibre-reinforced polymer-faced external door leaf
objects.definition: An external pedestrian leaf with moulded glass-fibre-reinforced polymer face skins over a framed and cored construction.
functions: Form moulded or flat entrance profiles
Carry documented hardware and edge reinforcement

cad.load: Composite leaf actions to movement hardware

objects.name: aluminium-faced external door leaf
objects.definition: An external pedestrian leaf formed from aluminium face sheets, extrusions or cladding attached to a framed or cored leaf construction.
functions: Coordinate lightweight skins with reinforced hardware zones

cad.opening: Joints and cut-outs follow selected fabrication
cad.load: Leaf actions through reinforced hardware zones

objects.name: battened, ledged and braced external door leaf
objects.definition: A traditional external leaf made from vertical boards or battens connected by horizontal ledges and diagonal braces on the rear face.
not_synonyms: decorative battens on a core door

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical boards with rear ledges and braces
cad.opening: Board joints remain explicit at detail LOD
cad.load: Boards to ledges and braces, then hinges

notes: Brace direction and hinge side are linked; the generator must mirror the assembly correctly when handing changes.

objects.name: external flush-door leaf perimeter frame
objects.definition: The concealed timber, engineered-wood, metal or composite frame around the edges of a flush or sandwich external leaf, supporting skins, edge hardware and core materials.
functions: Define and stiffen the leaf perimeter
Support face skins and edge lipping

cad.pattern: Closed rectangular frame within leaf edges
cad.opening: May frame glazing and hardware cut-outs
cad.load: Transfers leaf actions between faces, core and hardware

objects.name: external flush-door face skin
objects.definition: A flat or moulded sheet forming one broad face of a flush or sandwich external door leaf and bonded to its perimeter frame and core.
functions: Contribute to composite stiffness where documented

cad.pattern: One sheet on each broad leaf face
cad.opening: Cut-outs follow glazing and hardware preparation
cad.load: Acts with core and frame only as documented

objects.name: solid-timber stave door core
objects.definition: A door core made from closely assembled solid or laminated timber strips forming a substantially solid internal panel between the leaf faces.
functions: Provide hardware and edge support where designed

cad.pattern: Repeated timber strips filling leaf interior
cad.placement: Between face skins inside leaf frame
cad.opening: Omitted at documented glazing or hardware cavities
cad.load: Composite action only as selected product documents

objects.name: wood-particle external door core
objects.definition: A dense engineered-wood particleboard or fibreboard panel used as the internal core of a compatible external door leaf.
functions: Provide mass and a continuous bonded substrate

cad.load: Composite action only as documented

objects.name: foam-insulation external door core
objects.definition: A rigid cellular polymer or mineral-based insulating core bonded or fitted between face skins in an external pedestrian door leaf.
functions: Reduce heat flow where tested as part of the leaf
Support face skins within the selected construction

cad.opening: Interrupted at hardware and glazing reinforcement
cad.load: Supports skins only as documented

notes: Do not assign a whole-door R-value from core thickness alone.

objects.name: honeycomb external door core
objects.definition: A lightweight cellular paper, aluminium or polymer core bonded between external door face skins in a product specifically documented for the intended exposure.
functions: Space and support the face skins

cad.pattern: Repeated cells filling selected leaf cavity
cad.placement: Between face skins and inside perimeter frame
cad.opening: Stops at lock blocks and apertures
cad.load: Sandwich support only as selected product documents

notes: An internal-door honeycomb object is not automatically suitable outside; the material identity can be related while product exposure stays distinct.

objects.name: external door leaf lock block
objects.definition: A local solid block or reinforced zone inside an external leaf that receives lock, latch, handle or pull-handle fixings.
functions: Provide solid fixing for door furniture
Distribute lock loads into leaf construction
Preserve core material around hardware preparation

cad.pattern: One or more local blocks at hardware positions
cad.opening: Contains drilled and morticed hardware zones
cad.load: Hardware forces into leaf frame and skins

objects.name: external door leaf edge lipping
objects.definition: A solid strip fixed around one or more edges of an external leaf to protect and finish the core edge and provide a workable hardware or sealing surface.
functions: Provide a trim and sealing surface
Allow controlled fitting to the frame

cad.pattern: Continuous strips along selected leaf edges
cad.opening: Mortices and seal grooves cut into selected lengths
cad.load: Local edge and hardware loads to leaf frame

objects.name: external door leaf stile
objects.definition: A vertical side member of a framed external door leaf, identified by hinge, lock or meeting role.
functions: Carry hinges, lock or meeting hardware

cad.pattern: One vertical member at each framed-leaf side
cad.load: Leaf actions between rails, hardware and frame

objects.name: external door leaf top rail
objects.definition: The upper horizontal member connecting the stiles of a framed external door leaf.
functions: Close the top of the leaf frame
Bound the upper panel or glazing field

cad.pattern: One horizontal member at leaf top
cad.load: Frame action between stiles

objects.name: external door leaf bottom rail
objects.definition: The lower horizontal member connecting the stiles of a framed external door leaf, often deeper than other rails to resist exposure and support bottom-edge hardware or weathering.
functions: Close the bottom of the leaf frame
Support the bottom edge and weathering interface

cad.pattern: One horizontal member at leaf bottom
cad.opening: Carries bottom seal or drip preparation
cad.load: Frame and local impact action between stiles

objects.name: external door leaf intermediate rail
objects.definition: A horizontal member between the top and bottom rails of a framed external leaf, dividing panel or glazing fields and sometimes carrying lock hardware.
functions: Provide a hardware or hand-contact zone where selected

cad.pattern: One or more horizontal members within leaf
cad.load: Frame action between stiles

notes: A lock rail is an intermediate rail with a lock-support role, not every mid rail.

objects.name: external door leaf muntin
objects.definition: A vertical intermediate member dividing panels or glazing within a framed external door leaf.

cad.load: Local infill support between rails

objects.name: external door leaf infill panel
objects.definition: A solid or engineered panel retained within the stiles, rails and muntins of a framed external leaf.
functions: Form the visible door face pattern
Accommodate timber movement or engineered-panel behaviour as detailed

cad.opening: Occupies the field rather than creating an opening
cad.load: Retained by surrounding frame; movement allowance preserved

objects.name: external door leaf glazing aperture
objects.definition: A factory-made or documented opening through an external door leaf prepared to receive a compatible glazing system.
functions: Define the cut edge needing reinforcement and sealing
materials: void bounded by leaf frame or reinforced cut edge

cad.pattern: One or more voids through leaf
cad.load: Opening interrupts leaf; reinforcement follows selected product

notes: Reuse glazing catalogue panes, beads, gaskets and setting blocks rather than creating external-door copies.

objects.name: external rebated timber door frame
objects.definition: A timber external door frame whose head and jamb profiles contain an integral rebate that receives the closed leaf and perimeter seals.
functions: Provide a continuous rebate and weather-seal surface
not_synonyms: flat internal jamb with loose stop

cad.pattern: Two jambs and one head with continuous rebate
cad.load: Hinge and latch loads through frame anchors to wall

objects.name: external metal pedestrian-door frame
objects.definition: A formed or extruded steel or aluminium frame around an external pedestrian leaf, with integral or attached stops, seals, threshold and wall anchors.
functions: Define leaf clearances and closed position
Connect the door to wall weathering and structure

cad.opening: Inner profile bounds leaf and passage
cad.load: Hardware loads through reinforced sections and anchors

objects.name: external door frame head
objects.definition: The horizontal upper member of an external pedestrian-door frame, carrying the stop or rebate, head seal and any closer or top-pivot preparation.
functions: Bound the top of the leaf opening

cad.opening: Lower face defines leaf head clearance
cad.load: Frame and local hardware actions to jambs and anchors

objects.name: external door hinge jamb
objects.definition: The vertical frame member carrying the hinges or side-mounted pivot hardware of an external pedestrian leaf.
functions: Define one side of the doorway
Transfer leaf weight and wind actions to the wall

cad.pattern: One vertical member at hinge side
cad.opening: Inside face and rebate bound passage
cad.load: Leaf reactions through hinges and anchors to wall

objects.name: external door lock jamb
objects.definition: The vertical frame member at the closing edge of an external leaf, prepared for latch, deadbolt, multipoint receivers and perimeter seals.
functions: Define the closing side of the doorway

cad.pattern: One vertical member at closing side
cad.opening: Inside face and stop bound passage
cad.load: Latch, lock and closing actions through anchors to wall

objects.name: external door frame stop or rebate
objects.definition: The integral shoulder or fixed section on an external frame against which the closed leaf is located and its perimeter seal is compressed.
functions: Carry or back the perimeter weather seal

cad.pattern: Continuous around frame head and jambs
cad.end: Around head to opposite threshold end
cad.load: Closing impact into frame

notes: An integral rebated jamb and a flat jamb with an applied stop can make similar geometry but are different fabrication choices.

objects.name: external pedestrian-door threshold
objects.definition: The horizontal lower frame or transition profile beneath an external pedestrian leaf, supporting traffic and coordinating the door-bottom seal, finished levels, drainage and weathering.
functions: Provide a door-bottom sealing or drainage surface
Bridge or separate internal and external finished levels

cad.opening: Traffic crosses the profile; door closes above or against it
cad.load: Foot traffic to floor or sill support

notes: Threshold is a physical profile; clearances, step-free limits and water paths are constraints and evidence around it.

objects.name: timber external door threshold
objects.definition: A durable or treated timber sill profile forming the base of an external pedestrian-door frame and a bearing or sealing surface beneath the leaf.

cad.pattern: One shaped timber length across frame base
cad.opening: Upper profile follows leaf and seal
cad.load: Traffic and frame loads to floor or sub-sill

objects.name: aluminium external-door weather threshold
objects.definition: An extruded aluminium doorway threshold shaped to provide a sealing contact, drainage or level transition beneath an external pedestrian leaf.

cad.placement: At frame base beneath closed leaf
cad.opening: Profile remains inside traffic and sealing zones
cad.load: Traffic to substrate through full support or fasteners

objects.name: external door sill pan flashing
objects.definition: A tray-like flashing beneath and behind an external door threshold that collects incidental water and directs it to the exterior without draining into the floor or wall.
functions: Collect water reaching the sill interface
Discharge water outward with turned-up ends and rear edge

cad.pattern: Continuous tray beneath threshold with turned ends
cad.opening: Penetrations and end joints remain sealed as detailed
cad.load: Supported beneath threshold; not a spanning member

notes: The sill pan and visible threshold are separate layers and may extend to different boundaries.

objects.name: external pedestrian-door frame anchor
objects.definition: A screw, bolt, strap, lug or proprietary anchor connecting an external door frame to the wall or floor support at a documented position.
functions: Fix the frame to supporting construction
Transfer leaf, latch, wind and operating actions

cad.pattern: Repeated at scheduled frame fixing points
cad.placement: Through or from frame into wall or floor support
cad.opening: Prepared hole or concealed anchor pocket
cad.load: Frame reactions to host substrate

objects.name: external door head weather drip
objects.definition: A projecting profile above an external pedestrian leaf that sheds runoff clear of the head joint and upper door face.
functions: Deflect water away from the door head
Reduce direct wetting of the head seal
Form a drip edge beyond the door face

cad.opening: Spans over doorway without obstructing swing
cad.load: Weathering profile fixed to wall or head support

objects.name: external door leaf bottom drip moulding
objects.definition: A projecting moulding or extrusion fixed across the external bottom face of a swing leaf to throw runoff beyond the bottom joint and threshold.
functions: Shed face runoff away from the door bottom
Coordinate with threshold and bottom seal

cad.pattern: One horizontal profile on leaf exterior
cad.placement: Across lower external face above threshold
cad.opening: Moves with leaf and clears jambs
cad.load: Non-structural moulding fixed to leaf

objects.name: external door butt hinge
objects.definition: A two-leaf hinge with interleaved knuckles and a vertical pin, selected and finished for an external pedestrian door and fixed between leaf edge and hinge jamb.
functions: Transfer leaf and wind actions to the jamb

cad.pattern: Repeated on a common vertical axis
cad.placement: Between external leaf hinge edge and hinge jamb
cad.opening: Knuckle and throw clear the reveal through swing
cad.load: Leaf weight and horizontal actions to jamb

notes: The internal and external objects share hinge anatomy, but exposure, loading and selected finish are not interchangeable defaults.

objects.name: ball-bearing external door hinge
objects.definition: An external butt hinge containing bearing races between knuckle sections to reduce friction under a heavier or frequently operated leaf.

cad.placement: External leaf and jamb mortices or faces
cad.load: Leaf reactions through bearings and screws

objects.name: parliament external door hinge
objects.definition: A projecting double-leaf hinge whose extended knuckle position allows an external door to swing clear of a deep reveal, wall projection or trim.
functions: Move the hinge axis outward from the frame
Allow the open leaf to clear the reveal

cad.opening: Extended throw moves leaf clear of reveal
cad.load: Leaf action through projecting hinge plates to jamb

objects.name: external door top-and-bottom pivot set
objects.definition: A matched top guide or bearing and bottom load-bearing pivot assembly supporting an external pivot door leaf on a documented vertical axis.
functions: Define an edge or offset rotation axis
Transfer vertical load mainly to the floor or threshold support

cad.pattern: One aligned top and bottom pair
cad.placement: Between leaf, frame head and floor or threshold
cad.opening: Heel and leading edge rotate about pivot axis
cad.load: Leaf weight to bottom support; top restrains and guides

objects.name: external door hinge security stud
objects.definition: A fixed stud or dog on the hinge edge of a door or frame that enters a matching hole when closed so the leaf remains engaged if exposed hinge pins are removed.
functions: Transfer forced-entry load into the frame

cad.pattern: One or more studs along hinge edge
cad.placement: Between leaf edge and hinge jamb
cad.load: Forced-entry action into reinforced frame

objects.name: external door multipoint lock system
objects.definition: A mechanically linked lock operating two or more locking points along an external door edge from a common handle, cylinder or gearbox.
functions: Latch or deadlock the door at several positions
Distribute closure and security engagement along the jamb
Pull the leaf against perimeter seals where designed

cad.pattern: Continuous edge mechanism with multiple keepers
cad.placement: External leaf closing edge and lock jamb
cad.opening: Bolts or hooks project into jamb receivers
cad.load: Closure and security actions across multiple frame points

notes: Multipoint describes linked engagement, not automatically a certified security class.

objects.name: multipoint door-lock gearbox
objects.definition: The central mechanism of a multipoint lock that converts handle or cylinder movement into latch, deadbolt and linked locking-point movement.
functions: Drive the latch and remote locking points

cad.pattern: One central case in leaf edge
cad.placement: At operating height in closing stile
cad.load: Operating and security forces to linked mechanism

objects.name: multipoint lock jamb keeper
objects.definition: A reinforced receiver fixed to the frame for a hook, roller, latch or bolt of an external multipoint door lock.
functions: Hold the closed leaf at the jamb
Transfer local lock forces into the frame

cad.pattern: One keeper per remote locking point
cad.placement: Lock jamb aligned with leaf mechanism
cad.load: Lock force through keeper and screws to reinforced frame

objects.name: external entrance mortice lockset
objects.definition: A keyed latch and locking mechanism morticed into an external door edge and completed by compatible handles, cylinder or key operation and a reinforced frame strike.
functions: Provide internal and external operation as selected

cad.pattern: One lock case and strike at operating height
cad.placement: Between leaf lock stile and lock jamb
cad.opening: Mortice and bolt pockets remain explicit
cad.load: Latch and forced-entry actions into leaf and frame reinforcement

objects.name: external door deadbolt
objects.definition: A separate keyed or thumbturn-operated bolt that projects into a reinforced frame strike without spring-latch action.
functions: Supplement or replace the latch lock
Transfer security force to the frame

cad.pattern: One local lock between leaf and jamb
cad.load: Security action through bolt and strike to reinforced substrates

objects.name: external door lever-handle set
objects.definition: A pair or selected arrangement of external-grade lever handles, roses or plates and spindle operating a compatible latch or lock through the door leaf.
functions: Provide hand operation of the latch
Protect and finish the hardware preparation

cad.pattern: Handles on one or both leaf faces joined by spindle
cad.placement: At operating height on lock stile
cad.load: User torque to latch mechanism and through-bolts

objects.name: external entrance-door pull handle
objects.definition: A fixed bar, offset grip or shaped pull mounted to an external door face for pushing or pulling without directly operating a latch spindle.
functions: Transfer operating force into the leaf
Identify the pulling face of the door

cad.pattern: One or paired fixed grips on leaf face
cad.placement: External and optionally internal leaf faces
cad.load: User pull through fixings into leaf

objects.name: external door viewer
objects.definition: A small optical or digital viewing device installed through an opaque external door leaf to observe the approach side while the door remains closed.

cad.load: Light fixture retained by threaded body or fixings

objects.name: external door security chain or restrictor
objects.definition: A chain, bar or articulated limiter connecting an external door leaf to its frame so the leaf can open only a short controlled distance until released from inside.
functions: Supplement the primary lock when occupied

cad.placement: High or mid-height on opening side
cad.load: Tension or bearing through brackets to reinforced frame and leaf

objects.name: external door kick plate
objects.definition: A durable sheet fixed to the lower face of an external pedestrian door to protect the finish from footwear, trolleys, pets or repeated impact.

cad.pattern: One planar sheet on selected lower leaf face
cad.load: Minor impact to leaf face

objects.name: inactive external-door flush bolt
objects.definition: A recessed or surface bolt in the inactive leaf of a paired external doorset that projects into the frame head or threshold to hold that leaf closed.
functions: Provide a stable receiver for the active leaf meeting
Allow deliberate release for the full opening

cad.pattern: Usually one top and one bottom bolt on inactive leaf
cad.opening: Bolt retracts before inactive leaf moves
cad.load: Leaf closure forces to head and threshold

objects.name: external double-door meeting astragal
objects.definition: A vertical section fixed to or formed on one leaf of a paired external doorset to cover, locate, seal or reinforce the meeting joint.
functions: Provide latch or bolt engagement where detailed

cad.pattern: One continuous vertical profile at leaf meeting
cad.placement: On edge or face of one paired leaf
cad.opening: Moves with its leaf and overlaps the other in closed state
cad.load: Local closing and seal action into leaf

objects.name: external pedestrian-door closer assembly
objects.definition: A hydraulic, pneumatic or spring-controlled device and linkage that returns an external swing leaf toward its closed position at a controlled rate.
functions: Control closing speed and final latching action
Limit impact and wind-driven movement where selected

cad.pattern: One closer body and linkage per controlled leaf
cad.placement: Leaf and frame head, floor or concealed preparation
cad.load: Closing torque between leaf and frame or floor

notes: Closer power and access forces must come from the selected door, hardware and project pathway.

objects.name: external door holdback hook or catch
objects.definition: A manually engaged hook, cabin hook, magnetic catch or mechanical holder connecting an open external leaf to a wall, post or floor stop.
functions: Hold the leaf in a selected open position
Release manually when the door must close

cad.pattern: One holder at selected open-leaf position
cad.placement: Between leaf and adjacent wall, post or floor
cad.opening: Engages only near documented open angle
cad.load: Wind holding force into both attachment substrates

notes: Do not use a holdback where it conflicts with a required self-closing function.

objects.name: external door mail-slot assembly
objects.definition: A framed slot through an external door leaf with external flap, internal flap or chute and perimeter sealing components for receiving mail while the door remains closed.
functions: Close the penetration against weather and airflow
materials: metal or polymer frame and flaps

cad.placement: At documented position in door leaf
cad.opening: Creates a controlled penetration through leaf
cad.load: Light operating actions into reinforced cut edge

notes: A mail slot interrupts air, weather, acoustic and security layers and needs selected-product evidence.

objects.name: security screen system
objects.definition: A complete framed screen product and installation classified for security performance, including its infill, retention, locks, hinges or rollers, frame, fixings and receivers.
functions: Transfer attack actions to the building opening
materials: metal mesh, perforated sheet or grille

cad.placement: External side of, or within, a pedestrian-door or window opening
cad.end: Operable screen leaf or fixed infill
cad.opening: Preserves documented clear opening and operating path
cad.load: Attack and operating actions through frame fixings to substrate

notes: Security performance belongs to the complete classified product and installed system, not to mesh material or appearance alone.

objects.name: hinged security screen door
objects.definition: An outward- or inward-swinging security screen leaf, frame, hinges, lock and receivers installed at a pedestrian doorway.
functions: Transfer attack actions through hinges and locks

cad.pattern: One hinged screen leaf in perimeter frame
cad.opening: Swept arc plus required clear opening
cad.load: Leaf to hinge and lock receivers to fixed frame and substrate

notes: Model the screen door independently from the weather door behind it.

objects.name: sliding security screen door
objects.definition: A security-rated screen leaf that travels horizontally on rollers in tracks and locks into a jamb receiver or meeting stile.
functions: Provide securable ventilation at a sliding opening
Resist removal and forced entry as a system

cad.pattern: One or more screen leaves on parallel tracks
cad.placement: Along sliding door or large opening
cad.load: Leaf through rollers, interlocks and lock into tracks and jambs

notes: Anti-lift and interlock geometry is part of the installed security path.

objects.name: folding security screen door
objects.definition: A multi-leaf security screen closure whose hinged leaves fold and travel along a guide or carrier track.
functions: Maintain connected locking and retention across leaves

cad.load: Across leaves, hinges, locks and carriers to perimeter substrate

notes: Classification and installation evidence must match the folding configuration actually modelled.

objects.name: fixed security window screen
objects.definition: A non-operable security screen panel fixed over or within a window opening as a complete frame, infill and fixing system.
functions: Resist forced entry at a window

cad.load: Infill to frame fixings to substrate

notes: Do not assign fall-prevention or bushfire functions unless separate evidence supports them.

objects.name: emergency-egress security window screen
objects.definition: An openable security window screen incorporating a controlled internal release so an otherwise protected window can serve a documented emergency-egress function.
functions: Release from the designated side for emergency egress

cad.opening: Show clear egress and swing envelopes
cad.load: Closed-state actions through latch and hinges to substrate

notes: Egress suitability depends on the complete opening and regulatory context, not the screen release alone.
